mapper.select: SELECT c.external_id, c.envelope, COALESCE(k.status, 'inactive') AS status FROM channel_workspace_credentials c LEFT JOIN api_keys k ON k.uuid = c.api_key_uuid AND k.workspace_uuid = c.workspace_uuid WHERE c.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND c.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_workspace_credentials (external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, api_key_uuid, envelope) VALUES (#{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.APIKeyUUID}, #{params.Envelope,sensitive=true})
